sources.title: Calcium dynamics during trap closure visualized in transgenic Venus flytrap
sources.notes: Primary 2020 paper identified by DOI/title/authors and corroborated with author-group abstract and institutional report. Accessed through public third-party mirror; typeset copy has a publication-date placeholder, so not asserted byte-identical to the final publisher version. Direct Nature body/PDF inaccessible; screenshot retrieval failed. Statistical thresholds use normalized reporter fluorescence and probabilities, not an absolute universal ion concentration. Authors call for further causal investigation. Main text/method sections inspected, not all 18 pages or supplementary movies/data.

sources.title: A single touch can provide sufficient mechanical stimulation to trigger Venus flytrap closure
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed primary experiments with controlled sensory-hair movement and electrical recording. One deflection includes bending and return, not a stationary bend. Intermediate angular velocities can elicit two APs; very small/slow/fast movements do not all do so. No raw-data or source-video review and no new plant experiment.
sources.locator: PLOS abstract/introduction and Results: lines194–256 and266–288; methods discussion lines340–395 where returned. Single deflection versus held displacement; electrical measurements and force-probe trials.

sources.title: Demystifying the Venus flytrap action potential
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed 2023 review, not independent primary replication. Useful integration/timing context; review20-second summary differs from Suda fitted approximately30-second relation. Its older hydraulic mechanical account must not become the proposed motor explanation after the inspected2026 primary abstract.
sources.locator: Review introduction/Fig.1 caption, extracted lines111–138: electrical signals, calcium summation, approximate20-second memory, decoding and older snap-mechanism account.
